notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.5 - The Case of the Mystical Easter Eggs!
notes.notes:
[b]New Easter Egg Challenge: Find Easter Eggs?[/b]
The Ghoulish Gorilla is back again... and he has yet another project. This time, he is in need of some Easter eggs. At Easter. How convenient!
He doesn't want any ordinary Easter eggs. No, of course not. That would be too boring and predictable.
Instead, he wants Mystical Easter eggs! They can only be found once a certain riddle has been solved...

To figure out how to complete the riddles, you'll need to venture to the Secret Den HQ, located somewhere within one of the jungle gyms. In the HQ, you will find a board that will give you a hint on what to do next. Once you've seen the hints, you'll need to get creative! Don't worry, it shouldn't be too difficult.

Once all riddles have been solved and all Easter eggs have been collected, you'll be rewarded with some unique Easter-themed cosmetics! 


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- You can now choose which version of DirectX to use when launching Goofy. [i]For those using lower-end systems, using DirectX 11 is recommended.[/i]

- Crouching is now client-sided. The inputs and animations will now be responsive and smoother for clients.

- Added a crouch toggle option in the general options.

- Jumping and climbing is now possible while being in a crouched state.

- In Prop Hunt, playing as a small prop will now enable collision against other physics objects.

- Updated the hoodie model and the socks model.

- Cleaned up the 'ready up' UI and added a new keybind to go straight to the Game Settings as the host.

- Added warning strips in the sweeper section + button sections in The Complex.

- Added signage to some key locations within the maps, such as the football/soccer field and the space room.

- Slight performance improvements.


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.4.3 Patch Notes - Prop Hunt "1.5"
notes.notes:
[i]This is a smaller update that aims to make Prop Hunt more balanced and overall more enjoyable for both the Hiders and the Hunters.[/i]

- Hunters in Prop Hunt will now take damage when hitting props that aren't the Hiders. If they get eliminated, they will lose 5 points (negative points now possible). Stink Bombs are exempt from this, so they should be used to clear out large amounts of props without taking damage.

- Hunters will fully refill their health if they eliminate a Hider prop.

- Added a "?" that appears as a Hunter when a prop makes a taunt sound nearby. The "?" will not reveal the exact location of the prop.

- Removed the holes in the metal gate at the bathroom entrance.

- The taunt sound delay durations have been reduced.


[b]Some Other Notes[/b]
- Made some adjustments to the slide momentum + added ability to look around while maintaining the sliding momentum.

- Time Trials will now record your movement and will show a ghost of your personal best run starting from this update. Previous personal best runs will not be counted.

- The sweeper is now deactivated at the start of each round in Prop Hunt. The initial speed of the sweeper has been reduced when starting any other gamemode.


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.4 Patch Notes - PROP HUNT!
notes.notes:
[b]Prop Hunt, the 10th Gamemode![/b]
Here it is, one of the goofiest gamemodes to exist, and it is finally here in Goofy!

If you're unaware of how Prop Hunt works, there are two teams: The Hunters and The Props.
The Props must hide away from the Hunters until the timer runs out to score points. They will also score points for outlasting other hiders.
If a Prop gets caught, they will become one of the Hunters!

So, what is a Prop?

If there's an object around the jungle gym that seems small enough to be controlled, then you can probably become that object and turn into a Prop! Then you must blend into the environment in order to hide from the Hunters.

At the start of the round, the initial Hunter will start off in the newly renovated bathroom and will have a selection of Squeaky Hammers, Goofy Rifles and Dualies to choose from. During this time, the other players will be able to quickly find a prop and then hide!

It's up to you how you play as the Prop. Become a part of the jungle gym, hang out with the other cups on the tables or be a fridge on the trampolines, you can do whatever you want, just as long as you don't get caught!

(Prop Hunt is restricted to The Complex jungle gym.)


[b]Leaky Loo is now open![/b]
After being closed due to an unprecedented amount of leaking, the bathroom is now open once again! Leaky Loo contains everything from the original, but is now fitted with a funky renovation, so instead of taking a pee break in the ballpits, you can now do it in style in Leaky Loo!

Beware of the left-most cubicle, there are 2 wet floor signs for a reason. The renovation focused on the style and not the leaking... 


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- Added a graphics API notice in the graphics settings, to inform players if they're using DirectX 11 or 12.

- Added subtle physics to the player's animations.

- Made adjustments to how the first-person camera updates when looking up and down as a client.

- The Field of View now adjusts properly for those using ultra-wide monitors, preventing cropping.

- Team Deathmatch now has visible nametags for the enemies.

- Added a scribble sound when a button is hovered over.

- Increased the gamepad look rotation speed.

- Improved the way the third-person camera interacts with walls, it should be smoother in most cases.

- The third-person and the character editor cameras will no longer be affected by other players if they move in front of them.

- Bullets now affect physics objects, such as cups and bottles in the entrance area.

- Physics objects now reset at the start of each round or when the map is changed.

- The Reflection Quality setting now adjusts the mirror quality in the bathroom.

- Fixed a UI oversight where the Lives counter in Gravity would be capped at 15, despite there not being a real limit.

- The Goofy Points progression UI has been cleaned up.

- Added some helpful tips to the loading screens.


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Update Notes[/b]
- The Gravity arcade game has received some upgrades to make the gameplay more interesting and more enjoyable.

- Made adjustments to the ambient occlusion used with SSGI. With SSGI enabled, the game should look less flat and have more depth.

- During Weapons Race, players who are on the Stink Bomb finale will now automatically receive more Stink Bombs every 5 seconds.

- Fixed an issue where the outdated Weapons Race order would still be visible on the UI when replaying the gamemode.

- Changed the colours of the item pickups and the Tag timer pickups, so the item pickups appear more dangerous and Tag timers correspond more to its gamemode colour.

- Moved the buttons to the left side on the Create Server menu.

- Changed the Weapon Race default eliminations needed to advance to 3.

- Added interactable hoops in the entrance area.

- Fixed an issue where the star rooms and the arcade machines would be lit up when late joining an After Hours game.


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.3 Patch Notes - On Your Marks, Get Set...
notes.notes:
[i]This update features the next gamemode added to Goofy, Weapons Race! Although this is not a mode that was heavily requested, the pieces behind the scenes were already 90% in place, allowing an iconic mode to be quickly added to the roster of gamemodes![/i]


[b]New Gamemode: Weapons Race![/b]
Deathmatch just got even more stressful! The next gamemode added to Goofy is Weapons Race, where players must eliminate players with a selection of weapons in order to become victorious!

The only thing that will be randomised in this gamemode is the order the weapons will be given to you. Once you eliminate enough players with the weapon you have, you'll progress to the next one! But beware, if you succumb to a Stink Bomb attack, or get taken out by a rogue Banana Peel, you will be set back a weapon!

Once you have raced through all of the weapons, the final challenge is to eliminate a player with a Stink Bomb to win. 

The spawn rate for the pickups will be increased for this mode, just to make getting to the final challenge just a little more difficult! The item pickups will also heavily favour the Stink Bombs over the Banana Peels, so if you want to target someone who is getting a little too far ahead, you have all the tools you need to pull them back!

The host will be able to choose how many eliminations are required to advance to the next weapon, with the default set to 2.


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where climbing without touching the floor would prevent climbing from working.

- Fixed an issue with achievements not saving immediately after completion.

- Made slight tweaks to the Boxing Glove dash's floor angle detection.

- Made adjustments to the ragdoll force used with certain weapons. A change in a previous update exaggerated the ragdolls a little too much.

- Added extra details to the maps and adjusted the colour grading of the overall game. The shades of colour used on the maps have been adjusted to be more vibrant/fit the aesthetic of a real jungle gym more closely.

- The Original map has received some layout changes. (The time trial route is unaffected)

- Disabled items will now be highlighted in red in the Game Settings menu.


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.2.3 - NVIDIA DLSS 4 Update
notes.notes:
If you are using an RTX graphics card, the game will have already assigned DLSS to be enabled by default.

NVIDIA recently released DLSS 4, which provides greater visuals when using the upscaler compared to DLSS 3. This small patch has updated DLSS to the most recent version to take advantage of the improved quality, with DLAA now also being an option in-game for those who want to have higher quality visuals over performance.

This update also allows those with 40 or 50 series RTX cards to use Frame Generation (2x with 40 series, up to 4x with 50 series), just in case your graphics card wasn't already overkill.


Now we wait for AMD to release FSR 4... 🤞


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.2 Patch Notes - Team Deathmatch is here!
notes.notes:
[i]Deathmatch has been the go-to gamemode since the start... Well, here we are, Team Deathmatch joins the current roster of gamemodes in Goofy! The update also includes a revamped game over screen, character editor presets, some quality of life changes to items + gamemodes and much more![/i]


[b]Enter, Team Deathmatch![/b]
You've heard of Deathmatch, but what about Team Deathmatch? Well, it's here and it's just as chaotic as the regular Deathmatch! Everyone will be assigned to one of two teams: The Cheeky Chimps, or The Goofy Gorillas! Whether you want to play as a tactical team or become an unstoppable force, you can decide how you want to win as a team (less likely to be tactical)!

Before the game begins, the host is able to choose who will be on which team in the Game Settings alongside the other Deathmatch settings.


[b]Revamped Game Over Screen![/b]
Now that Team Deathmatch is here, the 3 podium spaces wasn't going to cut it for potentially 9 players squeezing into the camera shot in the Game Over screen, so this update now features a brand new space designed just for that screen! It's very colourful :)

In every gamemode that isn't Team Deathmatch, the #1 player will be shown and will be performing a random action, instead of the top 3 players. So that means no more showing off for participating, you have to earn your spot at the top!

In Team Deathmatch, everyone from the winning team will be shown and all will be dancing to celebrate their hard-fought victory.

Once everyone has seen their placement and their scores, there will be a vote on whether the session returns to normal, or if everyone wants to take the gamemode for another round!


[b]Character Editor Presets![/b]
Personalising your character is an important feature to Goofy, and with this update, showing off your outfits just got even easier! With 2 preset slots, you can now save your favourite outfits and show them off!


[b]Update Notes[/b]
- Friends Only is now the default setting when creating a session. (This is to prevent those from making open sessions and then kicking those who aren't friends)

- The game will now be desaturated during the pre-game countdown to make it clearer that the game has not begun yet.

- The score will now be displayed as time instead of normal points in Tag and Tag: After Hours.

- The Juggernaut's default health has been raised to 2,250.

- The Character Editor now has 2 preset slots for saving and loading your outfits.

- Added some colour variants of some already existing cosmetic items.

- Updated the Pointy Hat model to now resemble a wizard hat, with one colour variant locked behind the 'I'm A What? A Wizard?' achievement.

- The Boxing Glove dash speed has been slightly lowered.

- Dark Magic now deals damage when directly hitting the projectile on an enemy player.

- Fixed an issue where the bowling alley lighting would not reset when multiple players leave the area at the same time, i.e. starting the game.

- Fixed an issue with King of the Castle, where cancelling the gamemode would cause the game over screen to show instead of stopping the game.

- (From v2025.1.1) The UI safe zone is now adjustable, making it possible to bring it closer to the edges of the screen.

- Uncrouch blockers have been added to the crouch holes to prevent players from getting stuck.

- The reigning King will now fully heal when eliminating an enemy player during King of the Castle.

- Made some network optimisations.


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[i][b]Quick Reminder: If you aren't already aware, proximity chat is no longer broken! Why not give it a try?[/b][/i]

[i]This update brings the audio immersion up to standard by changing how all sounds react in different types of spaces, so now you'll really sound like you're there! On top of that, there have been some additional tweaks to proximity chat and many other smaller changes, additions and tweaks![/i]


[b]Update Notes[/b]
- Changed the default mic input threshold value to 0.2 so that mics will have an easier time picking up audio. (If you are experiencing mics cutting out, try reducing this value in the Audio/Voice options.)

- Changed the max microphone input gain value to 2.

- Increased the audible radius of the proximity chat.

- Added audio zones in every map to make all audio within the zones sound like they're reacting to the environment. For example, a long hallway having more echo/reverb than a small and enclosed room. This addition also impacts proximity voice.

- Added a subtle doppler effect to the proximity voice.

- Increased the damage of the Goofy Rifle and the Goofy Dualies.

- Added physics to the punching bags (still subject to tweaking).

- Smaller lights will now cast shadows if Shadow Quality is set to High or Epic, instead of just Epic.

- Squeaky Hammer knockback has been reinstated. As the Juggernaut is now able to fight back, the knockback is no longer a big issue.

- Disabling motion blur now also disables the radial blur effect that's used when going fast.

- Christmas gifts now inform players to drop/swap their item before trying to claim if they're holding an item.

- Fixed an issue where players could break their ankles in the ballpits when using the big slides.

- Fixed an issue where Dodgeballs wouldn't reclaim if the player had stumbled.

- Fixed some issues within the Character Editor menu.

- Fixed some gamepad issues related to the UI.

- Fixed an issue where selecting a map in the multiplayer menu would simply not load the map upon entering the level.

- Adjusted the item pickup prompt, now informing players to hover their crosshair over the item to pick it up.

- Added a delay to the Back button in all menus, to prevent a spamming issue.

- Added some invisible walls to prevent the player from un-crouching when there's still something in the way.


-sponge

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas v2025.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[i]It's the first update of 2025! This update prioritises making the Goofy experience smoother and more accessible for everyone, fixing the proximity chat bugs and there's also one big change to Juggernaut too!
[/i]

[b]A Step in the Right Direction for Performance![/b]
As Goofy Gorillas has been developed in UE5 for the last 2 years, it has been utilizing Nanite to allow for higher quality assets and UE5's unique way of creating high quality shadows. These features are limited to DX12, but more importantly, limited to those with higher-end systems. 

This update has reverted back to the traditional way of rendering, swapping Nanite out for the Level of Detail system and using the traditional shadows. The game should now perform much better for everyone.

On top of this, for those who have a lower-end system, you can now opt into using DX11 by adding "-dx11" (without quotation marks) to the game's launch settings on Steam. This was possible previously, but the results were not optimised at all. For those with more capable systems, using DX12 is still recommended.

The aim of this part of the update was to strip away the UE5 'next-gen' tech and make the game much more accessible whilst keeping as much graphical quality as possible. There may still be some noticeable drawbacks in the quality, but most of the game will look identical whilst having boosted performance.


[b]Menus and UI Redesign![/b]
It's that time for another menu redesign, but this time, the in-game UI has been changed around too to keep it all consistent. The buttons and HUD elements are now all much cleaner, making text more readable and clearer at a first glance. There has been extensive work done on how the menus function, with a big focus on ensuring all menus work with gamepads. This update makes Goofy fully playable with a gamepad, and it will be displayed on Steam. 


[b]The Juggernaut Just Got Stronger![/b]
In its original form, Juggernaut was in need of a gameplay upgrade. So, how about giving the Juggernaut a weapon? Why not give the Juggernaut a new way to gain their points?

In this update, the Juggernaut will now be able to defend themselves against the Hunters and are able to trade their weapon with the weapon of a fallen Hunter. The Juggernaut will now gain points the same way as the Hunters - dealing as much damage as possible, but if they don't get eliminated, they will gain an extra chunk of points! Surviving is no longer the only objective for the Juggernaut, they now need to be creating chaos for the Hunters too!

This update also removes the 3+ players requirement to play select gamemodes, including Juggernaut and both versions of Infector. So if you want to play these gamemodes with just 2 players, you can now do that. (It's still more fun to include more players, though)


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- The UI across the game has received a make-over.

- Proximity chat is no longer deafening! There's now a mic threshold slider in the voice settings to help with the game not picking up mic inputs.

- The Christmas Gifts now display a reminder to press them when close to them.

- Added a "Pickup Item" + input indicator when near any item.

- Any item that didn't allow for a secondary item to be equipped (i.e Dodgeball, Boxing Glove) can now replace the secondary item when picked up manually.

- Added a UI pop-up that shows who eliminated you and what they used.

- Banana Peels now have their own crosshair to help new players understand that they're holding an item.

- Added an option to remove head bobbing.

- Added a kick button next to the mute buttons. Only for the host to use.

- Added V-Sync as a graphics option.

- Reworded the upscaler help messages to advise players to not disable them.

- Added Invite Friends option to the pause menu when there are friends on Goofy.

- Respawning system has been adjusted. It'll now prioritise respawning further away instead of respawning at the same location as another player.

- The magic spells now automatically switch to the next available spell, to help new players understand how the Magic Staff functions. Can be disabled in the options.

- Fireshot and Plasma Strike have received a damage buff.

- Items can no longer be picked up while you still have an active Dodgeball.

- Reduced the amount of time it takes for a Dodgeball to become retrievable after bouncing + reduced the auto-retrieve time.

- Increased the swinging animation speed for the Inflatable Hammer and reduced the delay between attacks.

- Secondary items are removed if an incompatible item such as a Dodgeball or Boxing Glove is given to the player.

- Added a check to see if the session you're joining is actually still alive.

- Gamepad look inputs are now frame rate independent (typical Unreal).


[i]sponge[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.33 Patch Notes - It's Christmas!
notes.notes:
[b]Santa has delivered everyone's gifts... but where?[/b]
Despite having a busy schedule, Santa decided he had enough time to hide the gifts around the jungle gyms instead of leaving them in the entrance. How inconsiderate of him!
There are 3 new cosmetics that can be claimed, two are found in random gifts and the last one after finding all of the gifts.

Don't worry, the locations of the gifts are more forgiving than the Halloween wisps! However... not everyone will have the same hidden gift locations. Happy hunting!


[b]New jungle gym: The Complex![/b]
As the Refurbished map is seeing a lot more action recently and it has been a while since the Original map was released, I figured a new map was due. The Complex uses the same space as the Refurbished map, but the layout is way more open and has more room for parkour. This map is designed for faster-paced gameplay, so it fits well for Deathmatch, Tag, Juggernaut and King of the Castle.

This map features the spinning sweeper machine, with the speed being controlled with buttons in the map. There are 3 speeds: off, slow and very fast! Do be warned, getting hit by the sweeper will deal extensive damage, even to the Juggernaut.

Since the layout is more open, it is much easier to navigate than the other two existing maps, and is now the default map to help new players familiarise themselves with how the game works before they decide to venture to the big maps.

As this map is a lot smaller with no real hiding spots, Infector and Infector: After Hours are disabled. 


[b]Other Notes:[/b]
- The Christmas tree is back + snow has covered the carpet!

- The Game Settings menu has received an overhaul, making each changeable setting more defined. The Jungle Gyms sub-menu is now integrated into the main section to create one whole menu.

- Added Monocle & Moustache (level 31), alongside 3 new Christmas cosmetics from the gifts.

- Renamed Dynamic Venue Layout to Add Random Walls.

- Added extra text pop-ups at the start of rounds to inform players of what they should be doing.

- The Boxing Glove dash's hitboxes have been height adjusted + the dash is no longer stopped when hitting a player. Dashing through multiple players is now possible.

- Each Throne in King of the Castle now lasts 90 seconds, up from 60 seconds.

- Made adjustments to the respawning system. Players should now respawn closer to the action, or the current Throne in King of the Castle.

- Adjusted the Deathmatch default time and score limits.

- Added a warning when picking up a Basketball or Bowling Ball during a gamemode since they don't do damage.

- Added a mute function to specific players in the pause menu.

- The requirement for the 'Hey! Catch This!' achievement has been changed + renamed to 'The Firestarter'.

- Dodgeballs now deal bonus damage when hitting the upper body, but still not as much damage as a headshot.

- Added the 1-4 keybinds to the magic spell's UI when using keyboard + mouse.

- The Slimeball spell's damage has been increased.

- Added an option to remove player collision during the gamemodes.

- Fixed an issue with some video settings not applying.

- Small fixes with the control remapping settings.

- Made changes to the default voice input settings.


-sponge

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 1st Birthday!
notes.notes:
It's the 1st of December, which is also coincidentally the 1st birthday of Goofy Gorillas! 

To celebrate this milestone in-game, there are a bunch of new cosmetic items that can be unlocked, but it wouldn't be a birthday celebration without a silly birthday hat, which is unlocked automatically for everyone!

[b]New attire:[/b]
- Birthday Hat
- White variants of the Forward/Backwards Cap (level 6)
- Winter Hat (level 14)
- Frog Hat (level 17)
- Thief's Mask (level 22)

On top of the new attire, everyone will be earning [i]2x Goofy Points[/i] throughout all of December!


And of course, thank you to everyone that has been playing and supporting Goofy throughout 2024! It's truly an honour to have so many people enjoy what was meant to be just a passion project of mine, now it has transformed into a real nostalgic experience for many :)

-sponge

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.32 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]The Holy Grail of Dodgeball Changes[/b]
Dodgeballs have had a rough history in Goofy. From originally being almost useless if you missed your only throw, they are now an effective item as players can reclaim them from anywhere. One small issue with the Dodgeballs currently is that they are using actual physics in multiplayer... Let's just say that hitting players with these is not always guaranteed, but this new solution aims to solve it once and for all.

When a Dodgeball is thrown, it will now use a similar system to how player collision works with just about every other item in the game, but the closest example would be the Boxing Glove dash. While the Dodgeball is thrown and above a velocity threshold, there will be continuous checks to see if any player was hit in that time. If someone was hit, the ball will bounce off from where it hit the player. For clients, it may still look a little funky (multiplayer physics), but at least now you can throw a Dodgeball with more confidence!

The last Dodgeball addition in this update is headshot damage. Now that I have more control over how the Dodgeball hits players, dealing headshot damage is now possible. Getting pelted in the face now really packs a punch!


[b]Customisable controls are here![/b]
It's been requested many times for as long as I can remember, but it is now finally in the game. You can now change up your keyboard controls to make them work for your needs! To do this, visit the new Controls tab in the Options menu.

This update only applies to those using keyboard + mouse and not those using gamepads.


[b]Third-Person Mode![/b]
That's right! Despite being a first-person game, Goofy now allows players to switch between which viewing mode they want to use. The host is able to select which viewing mode is allowed during the gamemodes, with both being enabled by default. If you want a third-person only game, you can now do that!


[b]Stop Prank Calling Me![/b]
Infector and Infector: After Hours has a lot of downtime while the players seeking are struggling to find the survivors. With this update, there is now a new pickup that will spawn when a survivor hasn't been caught in a while. This pickup will spawn a phone that will then call a random survivor and reveal their whereabouts with a loud and obnoxious ringtone!

A Stink Bomb can be used to disable the phone and stop the Survivor's phone from ringing.

I know people will want to be able to turn this off to keep Infector as close to the basic version as possible, so this is an option that can be turned off by the host. 


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- Added 12 new additional achievements, some tailored towards being achievable for everyone and some being weirdly specific.

- Added new video settings to help those with weaker systems.

- Made lots of lighting adjustments and reworked the netting visuals.

- Changed the Pretty Lighting (Lumen) video option to allow for SSGI to be selected as a cheaper alternative to Lumen.

- The large lights in the entrance area now have their shadow-removing optimisation reimplemented.

- The small wall lights now cast shadows if the Shadow Quality setting is set to Epic.

- Default health values have been raised back to 100.

- Fireshot now uses the same player collision detection method as the new Dodgeball method.

- Many achievements have had their requirements reduced.

- Added a ring around the crosshair when the Inflatable Hammer is equipped, to show the current momentum/extra damage potential.

- The Goofy SMG is now a dual wield item. It will still function the same as before.

- Sliding is now client-based, so sliding should feel smooth and responsive for everyone.

- Sessions that are open for everyone will now appear at the front of the server browser list.

- The games room has received a small make-over.

- Climbing animation is now smoother while an item is equipped.

- Made some layout changes to the Refurbished jungle gym.

- Fixed an issue where players joining into an ongoing Tag: After Hours game wouldn't spawn in with a glowstick.

- Fixed an issue with two achievements wrongly using each other's progress.

- Fixed an issue where the proximity chat icon would still be showing even if proximity chat was not in use.

- Fixed an bug that would allow a player to keep pushing another player without being near them.


A smaller update will also be releasing in the coming days to celebrate Goofy's first anniversary!

-sponge

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.31 - After Hours: Part II
notes.notes:
Halloween has now been and gone... With 4 new magic spells and an easter egg puzzle that caused a collective meltdown within the community, the 2.3 update was pretty fun, but it was missing a pivotal addition that would have been perfect for the spooky season. Fortunately, many players really enjoy the creepy feel of Goofy with Infector: After Hours, even before and after the spooky season, so to continue on that trend, this update now adds Tag: After Hours to the current roster of gamemodes!


[b]More After Hours...[/b]
Tag: After Hours will have the same rules as Tag, You're It, but the map will be plunged into darkness. The Flashlights are out for this gamemode and the original items are back! 

Each player will have a glowstick with a unique colour that's attached to their belt. The glowstick will always be on, so you won't be able to depend on the darkness too much, so keep moving!

As a standard rule for After Hours, nametags and banana peel indicators will not be visible, so always be careful who and which banana peels you trust...


[b]Achievements are now live on Steam![/b]
Achievements have been in the game for a while now, but now they are finally on Steam! Some of the achievements have been renamed, some of the requirements have been made a little less grindy and an achievement from 1.0 has returned... 

Upon entering a multiplayer or a solo session, you'll begin to unlock achievements based on the current progress you've already made. From there, achievements will unlock as you play the game as normal.

All of the achievements will grant players large chunks of Goofy Points, so if you want to shoot through the lower ranks, these achievements can be a great way to do that!


[b]The Inflatable Hammers Have Been Reinflated![/b]
To originally make the Inflatable Hammer more interesting, I added a knockback while dealing good damage at the time, however since it ruined the flow of chases, the knockback was made significantly weaker, so it then just became a good damage item. Currently there are many more items in the game that are just simply more effective in every way than the Inflatable Hammer, so a rework was needed.

Out with the RNG damage system and in with the momentum-based damage system. Your damage with the hammer heavily depends on how fast you are going, but try to keep your socks on the ground because being airborne will add a penalty to the damage you'll be putting out!


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- Players can now select their microphone input and boost their voice volume in the Audio/Voice settings.

- Changed the Other's Voice volume slider's cap to 100, down from 300. Anything above 100 doesn't work with the new proximity chat method being used.

- Added a new warning message that appears in the Options menu to remind players to apply the new settings before going back.

- The Hold Sprint option has been added to the general options.

- The Goofy Zone in the Original jungle gym has received an ambience uplift.

- Removed banana peel damage from Tag and Tag: After Hours, they now just make players slip in these modes.

- Health pickups have been buffed.

- Added a button to jump to the Enabled Items section in the Game Settings.

- The Plasma Strike shock should now hit players more reliably.

- The delay that prevents players from sprinting after they have stopped sprinting has been halved. Sprinting should feel more consistent as a result.

- The Gravity arcade game now has a small and simple rules screen before the game begins, as many players were unaware of the extra points/lives pickups.

- The Dark Magic black hole no longer affects players on the same team as the player that cast the spell.

- Fixed an issue where the basketball and bowling ball wouldn't be removed from players if the gamemode ends.

- Fixed an issue with the character editor where the menu wouldn't jump straight to the highlighted option after switching sub-menus.

- Added a permanent slippery surface, similar to Goofy 1.0's spilled paint bucket area. (It deals damage during gamemodes, so be careful!)

- Fixed an issue with the bowling lighting sometimes being visible on the floor above.

- Every player's rank is now displayed next to their name on their overhead nametag.

- Deathmatch now has visible nametags enabled by default.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.3: Spells, Secrets & Spooky Stuff!
notes.notes:
Halloween is here, and what's a better way to celebrate the spooky season than to bring magical powers to Goofy Gorillas (amongst other things too)!


[b]New Item: Magic Wand![/b]
When the Magic Wand is equipped, the players are granted with spells that they can choose from. Each spell serves their own purpose and have their own cooldown after being used. 

[b]The New Wizardry Arsenal![/b]
[b][i]Fireshot:[/i][/b] A fast and fiery projectile that deals damage to targets that are directly hit. This spell has a short cooldown, but can only deal damage to one player at a time. Also causes a small knock-up.

[b][i]Plasma Strike:[/i][/b] An electric projectile that creates a small burst on impact. Any targets directly hit, or targets hit within a short radius of the impact will be shocked.

[b][i]Slimeball:[/i][/b] A heavy projectile that erupts on impact of a floor surface. The eruption creates a pool of hot acidic slime that deals instant damage and then ticking damage.

[b][i]Dark Magic:[/i][/b] A dark-matter ricochet projectile that detonates on impact of a floor surface. The detonation creates a small black hole that pulls players towards it and deals damage when close to the black hole.


[b]Mystery Easter Egg...[/b]
All this time there have been no secrets in Goofy, but now, there are wisps hidden in very discreet locations in the Original jungle gym. Collect every wisp and you'll unlock the next step of the puzzle...

Each step of the easter egg will reward players with new cosmetic items. There's a new cosmetic option available for those who complete Ghoulish Gorilla's Project.


[b]Mooooove![/b]
If you played Goofy during 1.0, you will remember that you could still attack when you were unarmed. Well, that feature is returning to Goofy, but with one fun change! Instead of knocking other players unconscious with one aggressive push, you will instead push them away. You can push enemies and yes, you can push your teammates too... Just try not to sabotage your teammates too much!


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- The persistent areas of the map have been spookified!

- The main menu and multiplayer menu have been overhauled. Sessions now scroll horizontally, allowing more sessions to be shown on screen at once. The host is now also able to select the jungle gym before creating a session.

- The Refurbished jungle gym is now the default map, both in solo sessions and when creating a server.

- Tag, You're It no longer has a time limit. The game will now only be ended if a player runs out of time.

- Renamed the 'Face' tab in the Character Editor to 'Face & Skin' to make the skin colour options more obvious.

- Added icons to the buttons in the pause menu.

- Added stronger gravity to the sliding so that it works similarly to 1.0 sliding.

- The wall hole obstacles are now significantly easier to climb through.

- Reworded the requirement for the Paw Slippers to 'The Jungle Is My Home' Achievement to avoid confusion.

- The Juggernaut's nametag will now be visible for all Hunters. The Juggernaut still cannot see the Hunter's nametags though.

- Replaced the Main Item option with the Enabled Items list in the Game Settings, where the host can enable/disable specific items.

- Made changes to some network settings with Dodgeballs to hopefully make them more accurate on the server.

- Removed some camera shake effects that were negatively affecting clients with higher ping.

- Removed bowling balls when Infector: After Hours is being played as the Glowsticks and Flashlights cannot be removed.

- Reduced the climb that the football/soccer ball can get from a kick.

- Fixed a bug with the Cancel Gamemode option.

- Bullets now travel faster, but their damage has been reduced.

- Stink Bombs no longer damage teammates and can now affect more than one enemy at a time.

- Changed the colour scheme of Hiders/Survivors/Runners to light blue to make them more noticeable against the other team.

- No more ankle-breaking from landing in the ball pits!

- Added an extra string to the alert screen that specifies the type of disconnection you've encountered.

- Added a keypad in the games area that'll be used in the future to allow players to use game altering effects.

- Added a red damage vignette that shows on-screen when you take damage. The strength of the vignette is based on how much damage is dealt relative to the player's max health.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.2.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[i]This patch is to mainly address issues with the new proximity chat system and the reoccurring bug that's preventing friends from joining each other's sessions. [/i]

- Made a slight change to the proximity chat upon joining a session, it should now detect which voice chat setting you're using i.e Push to Talk or Always On.

- Removed the max players slider from the Create Session menu. The max player count will now be 10 for every session. The option to change how many players can join sessions, especially in a friends only session was unnecessary and was seemingly contributing to the ongoing bug.

- Fixed some respawn locations for the gamemodes in the Original map.

- Added confetti to the game over screen.

- Made changes to the new bloom effects to make them weaker.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.2 Patch Notes - Original Jungle Gym Returns!
notes.notes:
[b]The Original Jungle Gym Returns![/b]
It has been a long time since the original map has seen any work, but now it is back and with a big make-over!
This map has taken the foundation of the original and has built upon it so that it not only plays better and fits more styles of gameplay, it now features more landmark areas so that everywhere you go should feel unique and interesting, all while maintaining the nostalgia vibe the original was known for... and yes, the bowling is back too!

This new map features a new time trial and a new Fruit Frenzy with separate high scores for each jungle gym. When you switch venues, the high scores list will show your personal best for the time trials within that venue.

This map is now the new default map. To change to the Reburbished jungle gym, visit the Game Settings menu as the host. You'll see the list of currently available jungle gyms and a description of each place. 


[b]Changes to The Randomised Player Selection[/b]
The randomised player selection has been improved for all of the gamemodes that use it. Players felt that the way the selection worked was unfair, giving other players more opportunities to be selected and leaving some players with no opportunities.
In this update, the player selection will use a weighting system. For each round a player is not selected, their chance to get picked in the upcoming round will increase. The weight will reset once picked, so the likelihood of being picked again in the upcoming rounds will be slim.

In short, this will work a lot more like a round-robin system but there will still be a chance that another player can be selected instead of the same order. It should give players more equal opportunities to be selected.


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- New item: Bowling Ball.

- New item: Basketball.

- Audio reverberation is now different depending on the area, i.e. tunnels, bowling alley and basketball court.

- Reworded some parts of the Create a Server menu so that it's clearer as to who the session is available to.

- Recoloured the inputs on the UI so that it's more easily readable.

- The respawn locations during King of the Castle will now be more focused around the current throne.

- Made adjustments to some default settings of gamemodes to better fit the new larger scale map.

- The Goofy Rifle model now has a plastic sight at the front and is now blue. The Goofy SMG is now turquoise.

- The fire rate for the Goofy Rifle and Goofy SMG has been increased.

- The Goofy Rifle and Goofy SMG now have a gun-related crosshair.

- The Goofy Rifle and Goofy SMG now have new animations while sprinting.

- Adjusted bullet damage for both guns.

- Adjusted the audio of bullet sounds and gun firing sounds.

- Added extra VFX when a player is KO'd.

- Adjusted the VFX of the bullet splash when hitting anything besides a player.

- Adjusted how the lights change colours in the stars room. The previous colour transition method was causing performance issues.

- Added extra information on-screen on what to do when the round starts/you change roles from being caught.

- Removed the auto item switching when placing a banana peel/throwing a stink bomb as a Survivor in Infector: After Hours.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.11.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch is more of an emergency fix to some large frame rate drops caused by some features that's planned for a future update.

The rest of the features from this patch were supposed to be included in the next large update, but I figured it would be cool to bring them in here.

[b]Notes[/b]
- Disabled a WIP feature that caused the huge FPS drops.

- The main menu backdrop has been changed to fit the theme of the game more accurately.

- Most menus have had their colours tweaked so that they are more easily distinguishable between each other.

- The Dodgeball reclaim system has been adjusted again as requested through feedback.
The time to reclaim the Dodgeball has been halved.
The Dodgeball will return automatically if not reclaimed at the end of the timer.

- Renamed 'Lobby Details' to 'Game Settings'.

- Renamed 'Settings' to 'Options'.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]New Gamemode: Infector: After Hours[/b]
The Goofy Staff have gone home for the night, so the whole venue is in darkness. Everyone will be given Glowsticks and Flashlights to help navigate around the jungle gym. Which item you get depends on which team you're on.

Just like regular Infector, the Survivors must survive until the timer runs out. This time, they have the added security of the shadows.

To add to the sneaky nature of this gamemode, there will be no visible nametags and the banana peel indicator will not be visible on any banana peels. You must be cautious if you find anyone, you never know if they're on your side!


[b]New Item: Glowstick[/b]
This item serves one purpose: help the survivors navigate around the play area during the After Hours gamemode.
It cannot be used as a weapon. Remember to be weary of when you use it, the light will reveal your location to the Infectors!


[b]New Item: Flashlight[/b]
The Infector's item during After Hours. Much like the Glowstick, its purpose is to help players navigate around the play area - but there's more!
It does what you'd expect a flashlight to do: fire a bright beam of light in the direction you're looking. The perfect tool to find Survivors hiding in the dark!
Since it can only be used during After Hours, there are no safety rules... so the Flashlight will be the main item to catch Survivors.


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- The reclaim dodgeball prompt now includes a timer that shows how long you have before you're no longer able to reclaim it.

- Increased the duration of time where a player is able to reclaim a thrown dodgeball.

- Reduced the amount of time it takes for the football (soccer ball) to respawn after a goal.

- Players can now pick up items while already holding an item. (Does not work by walking over the item.)

- The lights outside of the Leaky Loo now use motion sensors. If it detects movement, they will turn on.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.10.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]New Time Trial Type: Fruit Frenzy[/b]
Players wanted more from the time trials, so I have created a separate type of time trial. This time, there is no optimal route or order in which to go.
Instead of a linear course like the current time trial, there are pieces of fruit scattered across the map and you must collect them all to complete the challenge.
The route you take to collect them all is entirely up to you!
The personal best timings are separate from the current time trial, with the 2 boards showing the high scores near the Leaky Loo.


[b]Other Notes[/b]
- Added a new setting that allows the host to toggle the Add Time pickups in Tag.

- Increased the initial Tag timer from 150 to 200.

- Made the Multiplayer button more prominent in the main menu.

- Added icons to the score and lives in Gravity to make it easier to understand what the pickups do.

- Added slightly more time before the game starts after spawning/respawning in Gravity.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]In-Game Achievements[/b]
In this update, I have included a bunch of challenges, mostly eliminations with all of the items + a few other different challenges.
In the future they will unlock unique cosmetics and eventually will become Steam achievements, but progress can still be worked on in the meantime.


[b]Gravity (Arcade Machine Game)[/b]
The arcade machines are now functional.
No need to insert credits since it's now free to play, as long as there's no gamemode active.
In this game, you control a small cube and dodge falling debris and fireballs. All of the debris will add to your score.
A certain high-score may or may not be one of the achievements...


[b]Other notes[/b]
- Added the team name above the players in each team to clearly indicate what their role is in the game, i.e. Infectors/Survivors

- Added a 'How to Play' note at the Four in a Row games.

- Slightly increased the Goofy SMG damage.

- Banana peels will now always be assigned to the team you're on, including when you switch teams in certain gamemodes.

- Reduced the pre-game time duration to 12 seconds from 15 seconds.

- Made the prompt to reclaim the dodgeball more central and easier to understand.

- Fixed an issue where a thrown dodgeball sometimes couldn't be reclaimed + extended the period of time in which a player can reclaim their dodgeball.

- Added an extension to the top floor of the play area + some layout changes to other locations.

- Adjusted the Juggernaut particles so that they cannot be visible through the floor.

- All ready ups will now reset if a player leaves the game.

- Increased the hitbox of the bouncy section on the trampolines.

- Added a brightness slider in the video settings.

- Made changes to the Skylight colours (the thing that lights up the shadowed parts of the environment) so that the greens and purples can look more vibrant.

- Made some slight adjustments to the Lumen lighting so that the play area should be brighter.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.09 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]New Item: Goofy SMG[/b]
The newest item added to Goofy, the smaller sibling to the Goofy Rifle, the Goofy SMG!
This item shoots foam bullets at a much faster rate than the rifle but deals less damage, but that doesn't mean the DPS is less.

[b]Changes to the Dodgeball[/b]
The current state of the dodgeball is cool, but the glaring issue is: If you miss, you're in trouble.
The changes made to the dodgeball now allows the owner of the ball to force the ball back in their hand, like how skateboarding games let players force the skateboard back.
There will be a small window of time after the first bounce where the player can do this, otherwise the ball will be open for other players to take.
Hopefully the changes to the dodgeball now allow for more reliable dodgeball gameplay!

[b]Changes to Shooting[/b]
The current method for shooting is using actual projectile foam bullets. While this works for slow-firing guns, with the new Goofy SMG, a gun that needs the fast-firing to work well, having projectiles would not be a good solution.
The guns will now use a point and click system, similar to something like Call of Duty, but to simulate the effect of using projectile foam bullets, there will be a delay on the hit depending on how far the bullet would have gone.
This system should also feel more responsive and reliable, especially for clients.

[b]Changes to Running/Sprinting[/b]
The current system for sprinting, where players have a finite amount of stamina, has been removed. Now, you can sprint for as long as you like!
To compensate, normal jogging and sprinting speeds have been slightly reduced.
This change was made to address ongoing issues with how sprinting worked, to balance gameplay and to be more accommodating to the upcoming map, which is much larger than the current map. I think this will be a welcomed change.


[b]Other notes[/b]
Made changes to how the trampolines receive inputs to help high ping clients bounce easier.

Made changes to the jump input so jumping should be more responsive for high ping clients.

Items can now be used continuously by holding left mouse button or right trigger.

Climbing can now be performed automatically by holding the jump input.

The input to perform a big bounce on the trampoline has changed to the jump input. (Hold Space/A)

The Goofy Gun has been renamed to Goofy Rifle.

The selected player in Infector, Tag and Juggernaut will be stated at the start of the round in the top-left feed.

Made subtle changes to the item distributions when respawning to stop dodgeballs being stolen.

Increased the audio occlusion on the item pickup sound. It'll now sound more muffled when blocked by walls/floors.

Increased the proximity voice volume slider in the audio settings.

Tweaked some settings related to proximity chat.

Players can now invite friends to an active session in the pause menu.

Attacks/shooting will now prevent sprinting for a small amount of time.

Fixed an issue with the floor netting not resetting player's restricted movement when leaving the netting.

Fixed an issue where eliminating 2 players at once with a Stink Bomb would prevent one of them from respawning.


[i]I tried to add some other cool additions to this update, but I wanted to make these changes as soon as possible so that the gameplay can be better overall.
The next additions will be in sub-updates to 2.09.[/i]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.08 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Time Trials make a return![/b]
How well can you navigate around the map? The new time trial will put that to the test!
This version of the time trials are local-based, meaning everyone can play the time trial instead of having one player attempt it at a time like it was in 1.0.
The venue features a board that keeps track of everyone's personal best times for all to see, so now we can see who the real tryhards are.


[b]Four In A Row![/b]
The newest addition to the games area, Four In A Row can be played when there isn't a gamemode in action.
There are 3 instances of the game, so for the larger sessions, more players can play at once.


[b]Other notes[/b]
- Added a button in the pause menu that allows the host to cancel an ongoing game.

- Added a brief description to every gamemode in the Lobby Details menu.

- Changed the default frame rate to 60 from 30 (oops). Hopefully everyone has already changed it by now.

- Removed the cursor lock when in menus.

- Added some important information on some video settings and the proximity voice setting.

- Fixed an issue where a late joining player would be assigned to the wrong team in Juggernaut.

- Added visual and audio feedback when interacting with a pickup.

- Given health and timer pickups a prompt that tells the player how much health they've gained, or how much time has been added to their score.

- Adjusted the limits of the Juggernaut player's health.

- Made adjustments to the Banana Peels.
The ring indicator will now be just white instead of indicating the team colour.
You can no longer slip on your own Banana Peel after switching teams (i.e Infector).

- The Juggernaut sparkle particles now last longer, leaving a longer trail behind them.

- Fixed the Dodgeball being able to hit multiple players by the Tag player, causing more than one Tag player to exist at once.

- Updated AMD FSR 2.2 to FSR 3.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas 2.07 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Dodgeballs are back![/b]
They function similarly to Stink Bombs, they are now thrown with 1 hand instead of 2.
Dodgeballs are assigned to a player until the first bounce, then after a short period of time afterwards, anyone will be able to claim the ball.
Damage dealt by the Dodgeball is dependant on the velocity of the ball when it hits a player, so direct hits will do the most damage.
(Dodgeballs are still subject to change, so any feedback on them is much appreciated)

[b]Juggernaut is here![/b]
In this gamemode, the hunter becomes the hunted. One player will be chosen at random to become the Juggernaut, and they will be given a lot of health. Everyone else... will need to be very careful as they will be weak to any stink bomb or banana peel. They must try to take out the Juggernaut before the timer runs out.
In this gamemode, damage = points. The player that deals the most damage will get bonus Goofy Points, but only if the Juggernaut is eliminated.
The Juggernaut will lose points when they are damaged, so try not to get hit!

[b]Changes to Tag, You're It![/b]
There has been a core change to Tag to make it a little more exciting. Every player will start with a fixed amount of points, if they are It, their points will go down.
If a player reaches 0 points, the game will end. To stop your points ticking away, you must tag another player!
A new pickup type 'Increase Timer' will spawn around the map that will increase your points.
The default health has been set to 10 for this gamemode.
Survivors will still get their survivor bonus every time another player is caught.


[b]Other notes[/b]
- Updated the look of sessions in the multiplayer menu.

- Added arcade machines to the reception area. (Currently not playable, but will be playable in the future)

- Added a new unlockable torso. Unlocks at level 29.

- Fixed an issue where the throne area would appear when a player joins mid-game, even if King of the Castle isn't being played.

- Prevented Stink Bombs and Banana Peels from being thrown/placed before a round has started.

- Increased the audible radius for the proximity voice. Players should now be able to hear others from further away.

- Made the bigger trampoline bounce prompt easier to understand.

- Made some visual changes to the games area (previously the DJ area). Will be added to in the future.

- Added an icon on the tab screen that shows when a player is using a gamepad.

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas: The Refurbishment Is Here!
notes.notes:
The Refurbishment is now on the main branch.
Goofy Gorillas 1.0 will now be on a separate playable branch, just like how the playtest was handled.

Double Goofy Points is on until 8th July.

Banana Peels have been added. Players that slip on them will take damage, so be careful!

Added a Random main item selection for the host in Lobby Details.

The first player to reach a new throne in King of the Castle will now get an upfront chunk of points.

Fixed an issue where the health bar would show an incorrect value when joining a session during a game.

Fixed an issue where the countdown music wouldn't end if the round was already over.

Fixed an issue where players would appear where they were KO'd after respawning for a brief moment, before being sent to their new spawn location.

Fixed an issue with the throne areas not disappearing when the game is stopped early.

Fixed visible usernames toggle not working in King of the Castle.

Made changes to the item/health spawn system. Every round of refreshes will spawn a fixed amount of items/health instead of one at a time.

Made changes to some of the obstacle locations as it was making navigation a little too difficult.

Added a setting to turn off the HUD.



If you want to join the Goofy Discord server, press the link below.
https://discord.gg/ShUeRmG9CA



[b]Have fun trying out the new version of Goofy![/b]

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas: The Refurbishment Open Playtest
notes.notes:
The time has come! The playtest for the first major update of Goofy Gorillas is here!

The Refurbishment has been a long project up to now, redesigning the game from scratch and rebuilding almost every system in the game from the ground up so that adding further content will be much easier going forward.

I have taken a lot of feedback from players directly and through the many videos that have been made of the game. There have been many changes to the game and many fixes to already existing content. 

As this is a playtest, some features will not be present yet, such as character customisation and the Hide & Seek gamemode. These will be returning soon as a top priority. There may also be bugs and issues present in the playtest. Your level will carry over and Goofy Points will be adjusted to fit the new GP system.

The aim is to make the experience as smooth as possible for everyone, then eventually bring The Refurbishment into the main branch.

[b]So, how do you access the playtest? [/b]

On Steam > Games > Goofy Gorillas > Settings > Properties... > Betas

Select '[i]refurbishment[/i]'.
Steam will then update the game with the playtest version.

In case you were wondering if Goofy Gorillas has a Discord server, well, we do!
https://discord.gg/yArPmXXvYf

If you have any issues with the game, let us know in the Discord server.

- sponge

notes.title: Goofy Gorillas - 2.0: The Refurbishment Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a while, but I've been busy at work on the next Goofy 'update'. Let me tell you, it is a big 'update'. I think calling it an update would be an understatement. Everything you know about Goofy Gorillas will now look and feel much better. 

It is still in the works, so it's not ready yet, however there will be open playtesting available soon. 

The update will be appropriately named "The Refurbishment". I'll be showing more images of the game + revealing new features and also some much requested changes as the update gets closer to being ready!

- sponge
